verdict.rationale: x402 is architected as a per-request payment protocol (HTTP 402 challenge/response for a single resource) rather than a stateful cart/order system; the only checkout-adjacent mention is 'x402-enable a merchant checkout built on Payment Acceptance so agents can authorize payment sessions directly' (docs-13), which describes authorizing a payment session, not documented protocol calls to create or update a cart/order draft. No evidence pack item describes cart creation, line-item updates, or draft-order manipulation via x402.
